text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: To think even the Boss couldn't get it...
choice_data_list: Sorry. I didn't make for a very good role model...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No! You took on the challenge for my sake. For that alone, words cannot express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your earnest attitude in approaching the game
without fear of failure seemed radiant to behold.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be sure to use Boss's heroic showing
today as a reference for the future!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
